note: Reports Levent Alpöge's Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof, checked in Lean and said to be confirmed by independent mathematicians the next day, and that the 250,000-page proof is still being made human-readable. Sets out reservations from sceptics and the Association for Human Mathematics.
title: Math's holy grail, the Riemann hypothesis, appears solved with AI's help
who: Emily Conover and Kathryn Hulick (Science News)
